messages:
Maya: Quick status — targeting KV-cache evict/refresh milestone by EOD Wed. Kernel PR ready for review, reworked hotpath handshake and cut cold-start p50 ~15ms locally. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4928
Owen: Nice. Did you run the microbatch and regression suites?
Maya: Yep. Microbatch suite on x86-gpu CI is green except one flaky test `test_prefix_eviction`. I left logs + failure repro in the PR.
Radec: I can pick up the review tomorrow AM. Any particularly risky diffs to watch?
Maya: Touches `kv_eviction.cc` and `continuous_batcher.cpp`. Risky bit is the adaptive-window calc — added a guard TODO where we might need fallback to old behavior.
Lina: Heads-up: Dedicated infra will need a kernel flag to toggle the new handoff behavior for canaries.
DevOpsBot: Deploy check failed for canary in us-west-2 — missing runtime flag `--kv-prefetch-v2`.
Priya: I will add the infra flag and console toggle. ETA today 3pm PT (opening infra PR now).
Owen: If infra needs a toggle, let's gate rollout behind config. Can the console do dynamic flags?
Maya: Yes — plan is canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% once flag exists. Also need an owner for post-merge monitoring dashboards.
Radec: I'll own dashboards. What metrics do you want us to surface?
Maya: P50/P95 latency per model, evictions/sec, cache-hit ratio by prefix length, and error rate. Add regression alert on P95 +2ms vs baseline.
Radec: Copy that. I'll start wiring panels and alerts.
Lina: Quick question — do we need to update routing tests? New behavior can route to fallback variants when cache misses spike.
Maya: Yes. I'll add a small test fixture to simulate evictions and assert fallback routing.
Owen: I'll review the runtime PR tonight. @Maya please add a short repro snippet so I can run locally (load runner command).
Maya: Added to PR description: `wrk -t12 -c200 -d30s 'http://localhost:8080/generate' -s scripts/eviction.lua` — that should reproduce high eviction pressure.
Priya: Infra PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/1204 — adds `kv_prefetch_v2` flag and console toggle + permission check.
DevOpsBot: CI: runtime/unit-tests passed; runtime/integration-flaky failed on `test_prefix_eviction` — rerunning.
Maya: Thanks. If tests pass, plan to merge after @Radec wires dashboards and @Priya lands infra flag. Aim for Wed EOD canary deploy.
Radec: Wed EOD works for me — will prioritize dashboards and alert knobs.
Owen: Ping me after merge; I'll run a couple load profiles on Dedicated and inspect p95 and evictions.
Maya: Will do. Thanks everyone :rocket:
DevOpsBot: Re-run succeeded — integration tests passed. PR label: ready-for-merge.
